name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 11, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Jesse Ortiz of New Vision Christian Ministries International
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation to North County Solutions for Change declaring "An Imperative to Resolve Homelessness."
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer’s Cash Report for Month Ending April 30, 2013 (CC)
C4.
Woman's Club of Vista Donation (CC)
C5.
Adoption of the Fiscal Year 2013/14 Appropriation Limit (CC)
C6.
Second Reading of Ordinances (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-8, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California Amending Chapter 2.18 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding General Provisions and Requirements Affecting City Commissions, Boards and Committees."
2.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-9, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.44 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Parks and Recreation Commission."
3.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-10, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.46 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Public Arts Commission."
4.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-11, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.48 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Planning Commission."
5.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-12, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.56 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Senior Citizens Affairs Commission."
6.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-13, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.58 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Youth Advisory Commission."
7.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-14, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.60 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Traffic Commission."
8.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-15, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.76 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Mobile Home Review Board."
9.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-16 , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 1.20 of the Vista Municipal Code Related to the Use of the City Seal and City Letterhead."
C7.
As-Needed Traffic Engineering Consultant Services - First Amendment (CC)
C8.
Agreement for Vista/Carlsbad Interceptor Sewer Ownership, Operation & Maintenance (CC)
C9.
Supplemental Agreement with the Vista Fire Protection District for Fire Inspection Services (CC)
C10.
Revisions to City Council Policy 700-07 - Investment of City Funds (CC)
C11.
Appointments to Various Commissions, Boards and Committees (CC)
1.
Confirm the Mayor's and outside agencies' annual appointments to various commissions, boards, and committees; and
2.
Appoint the Mayor's recommendations to the Planning Commission.
C12.
Animal Control Services Agreement (CC)
C13.
Façade Improvement Program (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Façade Improvement Program; and 2012/13 Operating Budget.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the program budget for FY 2012/13.
C14.
Central Vista Business Improvement District Administration (CVBID) (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Ban on Smoking in Outdoor Dining Areas and Patios (CC)
1.
Adopt the sample ordinance provided by Councilmember Campbell, repealing and replacing Vista Municipal Code (VMC) Chapter 8.12; or
2.
Adopt an ordinance amending VMC Chapter 8.12, related to Smoking in Public Places; or
3.
Direct staff to conduct further research and outreach, and bring back modifications to VMC Chapter 8.12 for City Council consideration at a future meeting.
D2.
Draft FY 2013/14 Operating Budget (CC/BSD/CDC)
D3.
Five-Year Capital Improvement Program and Fiscal Year 2013/14 Capital Project Budget (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following resolutions approving the Five-Year Capital Improvement Program and FY 2013/14 Capital Project Budget and authorizing appropriations for FY 2013/14 Capital Projects:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- ,
b.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2013- ,
c.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- ,
d.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- ; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2012/13 year and approving the allocation of FY 2012/13 interest earnings to individual capital project budgets, and approving adjustments to reported TransNet cash balances between authorized SANDAG projects on the FY 2012/13 TransNet Schedule A.
D4.
CIP No. 8237 North Avenue Widening and Sidewalk Project Award of Contract (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the Capital Project Budget for FY 2013/14; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , awarding a construction contract to Dick Miller, Inc. for construction of the North Avenue Widening and Sidewalk Project.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Collection of Delinquent Fiscal Year 2012/13 Weed Abatement Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to provide an opportunity for each owner of land or other interested person whose parcel is affected by the FY 2012/13 Report of Proceedings and Account of Costs Incurred to present a written or oral protest or objection to such report and account; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving and confirming the FY 2012/13 Report and Account for Abatement of Weeds, Shrubs, Dead Trees, and Waste Matter.
PH2.
Levy of Delinquent Fiscal Year 2012/13 Mandatory Trash Charges (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding delinquent mandatory trash charges; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the FY 2013/14 property tax roll for delinquent refuse collection service fees and collection charges.
PH3.
Levy of Delinquent Fiscal Year 2012/13 Property Related Administrative Citation Charges (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding delinquent property related administrative citation charges; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the Fiscal Year 2013/14 property tax roll for delinquent property related administrative citations.
PH4.
Collection of Delinquent Fiscal Year 2012/13 Sewer Service Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding delinquent sewer service charges; and
2.
Adopt the following resolutions, memorializing the sewer service charge for FY 2013/14 and approving liens on assessor's parcels to be collected with the general property taxes on the FY 2013/14 tax roll:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , in accordance with City Ordinance No. 2013-4; and
b.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- , in accordance with Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2013-1.
PH5.
Levy of Assessments for Fiscal Year 2013/14 (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony; and
2.
Adopt the following:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , providing for the annual assessment levy of the City of Vista Landscape and Lighting District No. 1 for FY 2013/14;
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , providing for the annual assessment levy of the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1 for FY 2013/14; and
c.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , providing for the annual assessment levy of the South Melrose Drive Landscape Maintenance District for FY 2013/14.
PH6.
2012 Regional Transportation Improvement Program (RTIP) Amendment (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony on the City of Vista's list of transportation projects eligible to use transportation sales tax (TransNet) funds; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , adopting the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2013 through 2018.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
